capabilities: extract annotations from all PDFs in the current folder into the open note
extract annotations from a single PDF shown in the PDF viewer
extract annotations from an external PDF via a file path in the clipboard
template annotation output with Handlebars variables and internal or external links
group annotations by topic or export each annotation as its own note
extras: Known limitation documented under Issues: extraction works only on left-to-right highlights.
intentEvidence: This plugin builds on ideas from Alexis Rondeaus Plugin
problem: Obsidian can display PDF files but offers no built-in way to pull their annotations out into Markdown notes, especially for many PDFs at once.

relations.evidence: This plugin builds on ideas from Alexis Rondeaus Plugin but uses obsidians build-in pdf.js library.

summary: Extracts highlights, notes and other annotations from PDFs inside or outside the vault and inserts them into notes, grouped by topic.
